statement: The prescribed actual partial filling B4.19 has no proper analytic completion over its missing origin, even after finite coordinate roots and allowing three-dimensional origin fibres
depends_on: B.4.24; B.4.26; B.4.27; IKN2005E Theorem6.3; Parusinski1990E Corollary1.2; EH2024E Lemma2.14
R_items_and_Leads_used: Actual affine periods; full-rank exceptional monodromy; two extending sections; logarithmic trace cocycle
notes: Root and boundary_d full-source PASS. Direct coefficient-ideal equidimensionalization, coherent saturation, integral primitives, simultaneous product root and compatible star subdivisions, norms and Hartogs prove the fixed-partial noncompletion. This result alone does not exclude arbitrary r-only fillings with different r-axis caps.
